newsitem.title: USA: Nearby Brent advances in late day paper trade.
newsitem.headline: Nearby Brent advances in late day paper trade.

text.p: Nearby paper prices of world benchmark Brent crude oil advanced in late day trade as a number of cargo sized deals closed in the after-market window, traders said.

In trade dominated by trading houses and majors, paper cargoes of August Brent traded repeatedly at $18.05 a barrel and also at $18.07 and $18.08. August Brent closed at $18.00 in earlier trade on the IPE in London.
September Brent meanwhile retreated a touch, with partial cargoes done at $18.07, off two cents from September Brent's earlier settlement on the IPE at $18.09 a barrel.
Also, a cargo-sized August/September paper spread trade was done at minus 17 cents, traders said.
